text:
carmen_marketing: Team quick check  planning announce tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need: canonical changelog URL, docs prod link, bench soundbite, hero image path, webinar CTA, inbound webhook mapping. Who can confirm each?

devin_eng: Changelog PR merged -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/517. CDN invalidate in flight; expected canonical: https://changelog.redwood.ai/2026-04-02-runtime-tune. Bench soundbite: median 7.4ms/token (p95 18.6ms) vs prev 10.9ms, ~-19% cost per 1k tokens. Method: 25k anonymized traces, mixed batching, FP16 + quantization path.

lina_product: Product requests 15m canary starting 10:40 PT, then 30m ramp to full. Also need a 20-word banner line for the blog.

sam_ops: Ops scheduled deploy job #804 for 2026-04-02T10:40:00-07:00. Health checks: /health, token-latency. Canary OK. Hero image location: s3://marketing-assets/launch/2026-04-02/hero_web.png.

nina_docs: Docs are staged: https://docs.staging.redwood.ai/release/2026-04-02. Added "What's new" and quickstart (curl). Will publish once changelog canonical is live.

alex_growth: Webinar CTA: "See the new runtime in action  live demo + Q&A, Apr 4" -> https://events.redwood.ai/launch-apr4. Inbound webhook confirmed: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch-apr; maps to campaign=launch-apr.

carmen_marketing: Great. Two asks: drop final canonical changelog URL and docs prod URL here once live, and confirm hero alt text. I'll pin the email at 09:15 PT tomorrow.

devin_eng: CDN invalidate done, canonical changelog live: https://changelog.redwood.ai/2026-04-02-runtime-tune.

nina_docs: Docs published to prod: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-04-02. Quickstart visible.

sam_ops: release-bot: deploy #804 started canary at 10:40 PT, no alerts at 10:55 PT. Full rollout at 11:10 PT.

release-bot: Deploy #804: canary completed; full rollout completed 11:12 PT. No abnormal alerts.

carmen_marketing: Announce live schedule: blog+email 11:00 PT, social thread 11:05 PT, webinar CTA goes live in email. Assets: hero at s3 path above, alt text "runtime dashboard and GPU cluster illustration". Inbound webhook and CRM mapping verified.

alex_growth: Mailer queued, social posts ready. Will monitor inbound slack alerts.

carmen_marketing: Locking. If anything changes ping here immediately. Closing thread. :rocket:
